verdict.rationale: Otter documents natural-language AI Chat search across past meetings and connected apps, meetings organized by client or topic, and auto-captured action items. A founder could therefore manually ask about prior calls and open next steps. Nothing in the evidence shows Otter proactively surfacing past meetings with the same attendees, or generating a brief before a scheduled call. Missing for 10: automatic pre-meeting brief tied to calendar events, attendee-based matching of prior meetings, open-thread or unresolved-item rollup delivered before the call, independent or hands-on corroboration.
